senses.gloss: (cmp. טָפַף I) to join; part. טוֹפֵס q. v.
(cmp. טְפַז) to seize with hands or feet, to climb.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 7:10">Tosef. Toh. VII, 10</cite> <he>הרבים מִטַּפְּסִין וכ׳</he> many climb (over the fences) and walk therein.

<cite ref="Eruvin 21a:3">Erub. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם מִטַּפֵּס ועולה מט׳ וכ׳</he> a human being may climb up and down; Y. ib. IX, beg. 25ᶜ <he>כמִטַּרְפֵּס וכ׳</he> (fr. <cite ref="I00881"><he>טִרְפֵּס</he></cite>) it is as in the case of accessibility by climbing &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 11b:3">B. Bath. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מטפס וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. <he>מטפיס</he>, corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the chicken climbs &c. Cmp. <cite ref="V00843"><he>תָּפַס</he></cite>.
